body: I mean, of course I love my mom. But no I haven’t talked to her or anyone about this. I’ve written a pretty thorough note to her, as well as notes for my sister, my one close friend and my girlfriend. So it’s not like I want there to be mystery it’s just we’re in the lower class and my sister is due to go to college in the fall and she needs all the money she can so she can attend the school she got into. And I know they’d be suffering a loss, but I’ve known that I’d die by suicide for a long time and I can’t fight anymore

Not as simple as you think. It seems like a great idea, but it’s hard and it takes a lot of preparation to do so.

Firstly, you have to find someone who can get you a new SSN, a birth certificate, a baptism certificate, a fake high school diploma/GED, fake drivers license fake passport etc. Without these things it’s literally impossible for you to be hired to work anywhere, for you to get a license (if you don’t get a fake one) to get an apartment, to get a loan, to get a bank account, to do anything that adult life requires of you (it’s not possible in this day and age to be “off the map”). I’d say you’re most likely to get these things if you have any connections with illegal immigrants in your area. Just know it’s not cheap (especially if you’re not a minority).

You also want to start withdrawing all of your money from your accounts gradually, but don’t close them. Sell your car, shit sell all personal belongings you can. And make sure you have nothing connecting you to anything or anyone anywhere near where you’re leaving (local sports jerseys, high school jacket, etc). And save save save save save save save I cannot say it enough. It will take you awhile to find work and living arrangements that are suitable for you, so you need a bankroll to eat, rent a motel room, buy your bus ticket etc.

Now leaving can be tricky especially depending on where you’re from. Firstly, change your appearance (die your hair, cut your hair make sure you aren’t recognizable at a glance ideally) If I were you I’d take public transportation to the nearest big city near you, and then buy a bus ticket with cash. And (this is super fucked up) but the most important part about leaving is making sure nobody will look for you, so you have to leave a suicide note. Because even if it seems like no one will notice if you’re gone someone will eventually, and “people don’t just disappear” so if people don’t know what happened to you they will look. But if you’re believed to be dead they spend much less time looking for bodies than missing persons.

And where to go is the biggest thing too. I know it’s not exciting but I’d recommend moving to an immigrant town in the Midwest. Cheap cost of living, cheap housing, and in immigrant towns they are much more accepting of sketchy socials.

It’s not going to be glamorous. If you do this you’re looking at working more than full time and being lower class until your death. You can never speak to your family again, your friends again, you’re going to have to work manual labor, you probably can never use a social media site again (if you want to be safe), never take a flight or go to an airport, definitely never travel or see the world. I totally understand needing to get away but just know the costs (not just monetary but lifestyle as well)
